finding.title: Several exported policy outcomes can regress undetected

support.quote: description: `@${handle} will redirect to your Profile and use one retained alias slot. Your current Handle will stay @${currentHandle}, and its change cooldown will stay the same.`,

finding.failure: Schedule, keep, and reactivate could all return the schedule dialog and still pass because each description contains @old. The suite also permits retrying imports to stop polling while idle and unchanged loaded owners to be cleared: neither outcome is exercised. The exported aliasConflictMessage policy is entirely untested.
finding.correction: Use explicit expected dialog titles, buttons, and action-specific meaning; add focused cases for retrying while idle, an unchanged loaded owner, and action-specific conflict guidance.

finding.title: Polling and owner clearing share an unrelated test

test.quote: it('pauses import polling during writes and purges only resolved session transitions', () => {

finding.failure: A polling assertion failure prevents the independent owner-transition assertions from running, and one test name couples maintenance of two separately exported policies.
finding.correction: Separate polling cases from owner-clearing cases.

finding.title: No valid independent fixture proves HMAC interoperability

support.quote: - [ ] HMAC signing and cursor expiration still enforced

finding.failure: Successful decoding only uses production-generated cursors. Independently signed fixtures all have invalid payloads. Encode and decode could agree on an incompatible signing calculation while retaining a 64-character signature, rejecting different keys, and passing this suite.
finding.correction: Decode a valid independently HMAC-SHA256-signed fixture and verify an encoded signature against an independent expected HMAC over its payload.

finding.title: Blank rejection and absence of writes are untested

support.quote: Blank input returns Invalid and never calls write.

finding.failure: Save could write an empty string and return Saved for blank input while the successful-input test still passes.
finding.correction: Add a whitespace-only input case asserting Invalid and an empty write log.

finding.title: Pending interval is its own expected value

support.quote: Pending and retrying poll at 5000ms unless writing.

finding.failure: Any deterministic incorrect interval for idle pending status passes because both sides call the same production calculation.
finding.correction: Assert that poll('pending', false) equals the independent literal 5000.

finding.title: Draft assertion bypasses the public value contract

support.quote: Editor.set updates the public value property. Private storage representation may change without breaking clients.

finding.failure: Renaming private storage breaks the test even when clients behave correctly; a broken public getter can pass.
finding.correction: Assert editor.value equals 'new' after calling set.

finding.title: Opaque scenario names hide the polling contract
finding.failure: The caller cannot explain any scenario's status, writing state, or expected interval without opening the helper and translating arbitrary identifiers.
finding.correction: Put explicit status, writing, and expected values in the caller's table and pass those values to the helper.

finding.title: Independent policies share one failure path

support.quote: Polling and session ownership are independent policies.

finding.failure: A polling failure prevents session ownership checks from running, coupling diagnosis and maintenance of unrelated contracts.
finding.correction: Split polling and session ownership into separately named tests.

finding.title: Identity wrapper repeats the complete narrow matrix

support.quote: A higher-level identity wrapper adds no translation, synchronization or browser risk.

finding.failure: Every policy change produces duplicate failures and requires maintaining a second set of test executions without exercising a distinct boundary risk.
finding.correction: Keep the complete matrix at poll's public boundary and remove the wrapper matrix.

finding.title: Optional: flatten labels around the single interval assertion

support.quote: Nesting and snapshot size are optional advisory observations only; no numerical limit is repository policy.

finding.failure: Four suite levels distribute one simple scenario across generic labels, requiring readers to reconstruct its meaning from the hierarchy while the remaining polling rules sit outside it.
finding.correction: Optionally replace the nested suites with one test named 'pending polls every 5000ms while idle'.
